newsitem.title: USA: MMI blocked from calling Eastern meeting.
newsitem.headline: MMI blocked from calling Eastern meeting.

text.p: Eastern Co said Tuesday the Superior Court in Waterbury, Conn., enjoined MMI Investments L.L.C. from calling a special meeting of Eastern shareholders.
The court agreed with Eastern that the written request of holders of at least 35 percent of Eastern's shares was required under Connecticut law to call a special shareholder meeting.
The court, however, permitted MMI to inspect Eastern's shareholder list.
MMI seeks to call a special meeting to consider a proposal made by MMI affiliate Milbrook Capital Management Inc to acquire Eastern.
Eastern said the court described the acquisition proposal as a "highly leveraged transaction predicated on the loan value of the target company."
In July Millbrook proposed acquiring Eastern for $15 per share, representing a 30 percent premium to the closing price for the prior 30 trading days.
Millbrook said Eastern management rejected the offer and refused to engage in constructive dialogue to assure the best possible value for all Eastern shareholders.
